## TRA Timeline

#### Origination at Up-C IPO

- 2004-10-12: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.8 to S-1/A No. 3
- 2004-10-27: TRA executed at IPO close (Vulcan Transaction immediately preceded the IPO; DWI II contributed DWA LLC interest to DWA in Section 351 transaction; Section 754 election produced basis step-up amortizing over ~15 years)
- 2005-03-28: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.9 to the FY2004 10-K

#### Payment activity

- 2009 to 2013: Cumulative payments to DWI II of approximately $115M visible across 10-K disclosures; TRA liability declined from $329.6M (2010) to $262.3M (2013)
- 2014-FY: Valuation allowance recorded on underlying deferred tax assets, suppressing further accrual; contract still in force

#### Comcast merger

- 2016-04-28: Merger Agreement with Comcast filed; Section 6.1(b)(viii)(A)(B) restricts DWA from exercising any termination right under the TRA during merger pendency
- 2016-08-22: Comcast merger closes; closing 8-K reports termination of debt instruments but does not mention the TRA; DWA deregisters shortly after

## Explanation

This TRA originated at DreamWorks Animation's October 2004 Up-C IPO and obligated DWA to pay DW Investment II, Inc. (a Washington S-corp controlled by Paul Allen) 85% of cash tax savings realized on Section 754 basis step-ups arising from the Vulcan Transaction plus imputed-interest deductions, amortizing over approximately 15 years. No amendments or restatements were ever filed. The April 2016 merger agreement with Comcast preserved the TRA as a surviving obligation and restricted DWA from triggering an Early Termination Payment during merger pendency, but the August 22, 2016 closing 8-K does not address the TRA's ultimate fate. Whether Comcast settled, terminated, or retained the contract post-close is not visible under DWA's CIK; the dispositive disclosure would live under Comcast's CIK (0001166691). A 2014 valuation allowance suppressed further accrual but did not terminate the contract. Status is `Unknown` rather than `Ongoing` because the post-merger fate cannot be confirmed from this directory. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing record.
